company.name: Farcast
company.shortDescription: Farcast is a satellite tech company that builds advanced SATCOM user terminals to expand global access to SATCOM internet.
company.description: Farcast is a satellite tech company that builds advanced SATCOM user terminals to expand global access to SATCOM internet. The company's core offering is a flat‑panel antenna (FPA) using proprietary active electronically scanned antenna (AESA) technology. Its user terminals are engineered for reduced size, weight, power, and cost (SWaP‑C), while supporting full‑duplex data transmission and electronic beam‑steering to track satellites or moving users, making them suitable for fixed locations, mobile platforms, aviation, maritime, and enterprise use.

productsAndServices.description: User terminals featuring flat panel antennas that electronically scan beams to maintain satellite connectivity for moving users and reduce size, weight, power, and cost.
productsAndServices.name: Flat Panel Antennas (FPAs) with Active Electronically Scanned Antennas (AESAs)
